# Apple FY2024 source fixture

Unmodified official publisher Form 10-K, including exhibits. Although the CDN
filename contains `10-Q4`, the document is a Form 10-K for September 28, 2024.
Source URL, hash, byte length and six manually inspected source values are in
`annotations.json`. Annotations are test-only; production inference never reads them.

Income PDF/printed pages 32/29; balance 34/31. USD millions, consolidated scope.
USD presentation context is on PDF 30/printed 27; fiscal policy on 37/34.
FY2023 has 53 weeks; FY2024 has 52. Reported growth is not annualized. Period
boundaries are normalized from consecutive annual statement end dates, with
unchanged raw start dates. Row references and split date headers remain in evidence.
